segments.he:
(שָׁם):
תקסא
(קיח) שָׁמַעְתִּימִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁכָּל יוֹם יֵשׁ לוֹ שֶׁפַע שֶׁלּוֹ
segments.en: (118.) I heard from his holy mouth that every day has its own particular outpouring of blessing. (Likutay Halachos, Laws of Rosh Chodesh, Law 6 and Laws of Washing Hands, Law 1.)
